_comment: Throw Mine (docs/plan-prototype-projectile.md D5, P1): the MINE half of the D5 pair. It plants a ProjectileBomb 3 units ahead along the caster's LAST WALKING DIRECTION (D3, PO ruling 2026-08-15 over cursor aim), the bomb arms over 45 ticks and then simply waits, detonating the moment anything wanders into its burst - and fizzling silently at the end of its 30 s life if nobody ever does. ⭐ MINE VS TIMED IS AUTHORING, NOT A FLAG, and this file plus throw-bomb.json ARE the difference: a mine authors ttlTicks far above armTicks so it outlives its fuse and waits, while the timed bomb authors ttlTicks = armTicks + 1 for exactly one fire opportunity. No code branches on which one this is; the engine only ever sees a number. ⚑ THE AIM CAVEAT IS THE POINT OF THE PO SESSION (§10 item 7): kiting means walking AWAY from the enemy, so a fleeing player throws behind themselves and cannot hit a chaser. For mine-laying that reads perfectly - drop, back off, lure - which is why the mine is the throw the prototype leads with. The cursor-aim fallback is prepared and hangs on that verdict. A caster who has never walked has no aim at all and gets the bomb at their own feet: a throw never whiffs (TestProjectile_ZeroAimLandsAtTheCastersFeet). Thrown against a wall it clamps visibly short rather than landing inside geometry. CHEAT-ONLY, deliberately and for now: no unlock source anywhere, granted with `SKILL ThrowMine` for the PO session, because a prototype whose verdict may be `delete` must not enter the progression. cost 0 / cast 0 make the feel readable before anything is priced - what the throw should COST is a PO call the prototype exists to inform. maxLevel 1: binary-utility vocabulary, nothing here scales. ALL VALUES [PLACEHOLDER].
name: ThrowMine
